calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.not_capable: This phone's Vibb One doesn't know Dagen yet
calendar.not_capable_sub: What you set here reaches it once Vibb One is updated.
calendar.summary.label: Calendar
calendar.dagen.title: Dagen
calendar.dagen.on_home_sub: Off hides the tile, the lock screen's line and the reminders; the rules stay
calendar.dagen.footer: The kid's day in Vibb One, one day at a time.
calendar.dagen.info: The kid swipes from day to day. Events the kid adds go to the calendar you choose here, and the kid can change or delete only those.
calendar.kid.label: The kid's events
calendar.lock.title: On the lock screen
calendar.lock.reminders_sub: A quiet row before the event - no sound, no vibration
calendar.lock.footer: Anyone near the phone can see the lock screen.
calendar.lock.info: A title can name a place. The title rules below apply here too.
calendar.lock.example_caption: This is what a reminder looks like:
calendar.calendars.title: Calendars shown
calendar.calendars.reminders_off: Reminders are off for this phone
calendar.calendars.info: "The calendar's own reminders" are the ones the calendar itself has, at most two hours before. With "Reminders on the lock screen" set to Off there is no reminder, whatever you pick here.
calendar.calendars.no_report: The phone hasn't said which calendars it has yet. It does with its next report.
calendar.calendars.unreadable: The phone can't read its calendars. Vibb One needs the calendar permission, which it gives itself while the phone is managed.
calendar.calendars.none: The phone has no calendar yet.
calendar.calendars.setup: Paste the calendar's link under Calendar links above - that's all. Or, with a sync app: add ICSx5 (feeds) or DAVx5 (CalDAV) from the catalog's F-Droid source, tick it for this phone, switch On Home off under Apps, then in a pause open it and add the feed or log in. DAVx5: use an app password and read-only shares; sync every 1-4 hours saves battery.
calendar.rules.title: Title rules
calendar.rules.footer: First matching rule wins. The phone applies them when it draws the day. A calendar link's events are fetched by the server; the phone's own calendars stay on the phone.
calendar.rules.gone: That rule was deleted in the meantime.
calendar.rules.skipped: The phone's Vibb One can't use rule {ids} yet and leaves it out.
calendar.rule.title: Title rule
calendar.rule.field.title: The title
calendar.rule.match_footer: Capital letters and spaces don't matter: "Romerriket" also finds "R omerriket".
calendar.rule.keep_rest: Keep the rest of the title
calendar.rule.then_footer: Show as with Keep the rest: the text, then the title without what matched. Without it: the text alone. A rule on the description can only hide the event.
calendar.rule.delete_confirm: Delete this rule? The phone shows these events as the calendar has them.
calendar.rule.calendar_gone: A calendar no longer on the phone
calendar.rule.error.field: Pick the title or the description.
calendar.rule.error.pattern_empty: Type the text to look for.
calendar.rule.error.pattern_long: The text to look for is at most 120 characters.
calendar.rule.error.then: Pick Show as or Hide the event.
calendar.rule.error.description_hides: A rule on the description can only hide the event.
calendar.rule.error.text_empty: Type the text to show, or keep the rest of the title.
calendar.rule.error.text_long: The text to show is at most 40 characters.
calendar.rule.error.calendar: Pick one of the phone's calendars.
calendar.rule.error.too_many: This phone has 30 rules already - delete one first.
calendar.preview.title: Preview
calendar.preview.footer: Paste a real title to see what the phone will show. Only what you paste is checked: no event ever leaves the phone.
calendar.preview.no_match: No rule matches: the phone shows it as it is.
calendar.error.read: Couldn't read the calendar settings - check the server log.
calendar.error.save: Couldn't save - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
calendar.error.kid_calendar: Not a calendar the kid can add events to.
calendar.error.move: Move a rule up or down.
calendar.kid.gone: The chosen calendar - not on the phone now
calendar.links.title: Calendar links
calendar.links.footer: Paste a calendar's link (https or webcal). The server fetches it every hour; the phone shows it in Dagen.
calendar.links.info: The server fetches the link every hour, and Fetch now fetches it at once. Each phone with the link gets its events in a calendar of its own, which the kid can't change. Nothing more than 60 days old is sent, so a day further back shows nothing from a link.
calendar.links.info_privacy: The server keeps the linked calendar's events (titles, descriptions, places, times) while the link is here, and sends them only to the phones that have it. The link is stored encrypted and never shown again - only its host. The events the kid adds on the phone stay on the phone.
calendar.links.name: Name
calendar.links.remove_confirm: The calendar goes off this phone. ICSx5's calendars are not touched.
calendar.links.no_key: Calendar links are off: the server has no key to store a link encrypted. Check the server log (MUSIC_SECRET_KEY).
calendar.links.full: This phone has 10 links already - remove one first.
calendar.links.update_phone: Update Vibb One on the phone to see this calendar
calendar.links.maybe_same: May be the same as the calendar link {name}
calendar.links.fetch_wait: Fetched a moment ago - try again in a few minutes.
calendar.links.status.held_empty: The link gave no events - showing the last ones (fetched {when}).
calendar.links.status.unknown_tz: {count} events with an unknown time zone - shown in the phone's time
calendar.links.status.cut: {count} events left out: the calendar is too large
calendar.links.status.churn: Every event is new at each fetch - fetched every 6 hours
calendar.links.status.lan_http: Plain http on the home network: safe only if the way there is encrypted (WireGuard, Tailscale).
calendar.links.why.timeout: The link didn't answer in time.
calendar.links.why.too_big: The calendar is larger than 5 MB.
calendar.links.why.not_calendar: The link gave a web page, not a calendar - use the calendar's own link (ICS).
calendar.links.why.private_address: The link led to a private address.
calendar.links.why.key_lost: The server's key has changed - add the link again.
calendar.links.why.insecure: Plain http to the internet is refused - use https.
calendar.links.error.no_key: Nothing can be stored without the server's key. Check the server log (MUSIC_SECRET_KEY).
calendar.links.error.not_link: That isn't a link - paste the calendar's address (https:// or webcal://).
calendar.links.error.userinfo: A link with a user name or password doesn't work here.
calendar.links.error.too_long: The link is longer than 2000 characters.
calendar.links.error.too_many: This phone has 10 links already - remove one first.
calendar.links.error.too_many_sources: This server has 50 calendar links already.
calendar.links.error.http_public: Plain http to the internet is refused - use the https link.
apps.on_home_sub: Off: the app stays allowed and runs, but the kid doesn't see it on Home or in the app list, except during a pause - for a sync app such as ICSx5 or DAVx5.
